svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-epc-to-net-margin-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Gross reported commissions to net owner profit; subtitle: Illustrative $1,000 gross reported affiliate commission cohort; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per $1,000 gross dashboard commissions; opening and closing bars are totals, middle bars are deductions.; caption: Separate merchant GMV from gross reported commissions, deduct reversals first, and fund media/contractors out of settled Net EPC.; stages: label: Gross reported payouts; value: $1,000; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: Initial CPA bounties, qualified call transfers, and recurring SaaS shares logged before locking.; label: Scrubs & clawbacks; value: -$150; numeric value: -150.0; detail: 15% duplicate-CRM leads, <45-day trial cancellations, and refund/chargeback reversals.; label: Paid media & co-reg; value: -$265; numeric value: -265.0; detail: Bounded exact-match comparison search and SparkLoop co-reg spend net of Day-0 recoup.; label: Editorial & video pod; value: -$210; numeric value: -210.0; detail: Two specialized part-time contractors producing substantiated guides, calculators, and YouTube demos.; label: Edge, S2S & compliance; value: -$77; numeric value: -77.0; detail: ClickFlare/Everflow S2S tracking, Ringba routing, SERP/GEO intelligence, and substantiation ops.; label: Owner net profit; value: $298; numeric value: 298.0; detail: 35.1% Base-Case net margin on $850 net earned commissions (20% Conservative -> 50% Scaled).
